landing.title: Together
landing.lead: A moment to slow down together. To feel, to listen, and to rediscover the quiet beauty of connection.
landing.intro: Sit side by side, or facing each other. Each of you listens on your own phone, with your own headphones, to the same guiding voice at the same moment.

rituals.title: Heart to Heart
rituals.subtitle: A Guided Ritual for Connection
rituals.lead: A quiet ritual for two people, sitting side by side or facing each other. One voice guides you both through presence, breath and, if you both wish, gentle touch.

phases.name: Arrival
phases.text: Land in your body, and notice the presence of the person beside you.

phases.name: Heart Connection
phases.text: One hand rests over your own heart. If you both wish, the other rests gently over your partner's: warmth, skin, contact, the quiet weight of a hand.

phases.name: Shared Breathing
phases.text: Notice each other's breath, and let your own come a little closer to a shared rhythm, without forcing anything.

phases.name: Deepening Connection
phases.text: Eye contact, if it feels comfortable. Touch, stillness, presence.

phases.name: Integration
phases.text: A closing moment to feel what you have shared, and to carry it into the rest of your day.

rituals.consent: Everything here is an invitation. Touch and eye contact are always optional, and you are welcome to keep your hands on your own hearts.
rituals.disclaimer: A ritual of attention and care. It is not a treatment, and it makes no promises about your body or your breathing.

audio._cues: Fill in when the recording is final: [{"at": 0, "phase": 0}, {"at": 105, "phase": 1}, ...] with 'at' in seconds and 'phase' the index in 'phases'. The screen then names the phase while it plays. Leave null until then.
